text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause mild issues like frequent urination and yeast infections, as well as rare, serious conditions like ketoacidosis and dehydration.
For comprehensive official details, visit the Jardiance Official Site.

list.snippet: Increased urination: Passing more urine or getting up at night because the drug removes excess sugar through the kidneys.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, redness, or discharge in women or men due to sugar in the urine.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning pain when peeing or cloudy urine.
Upper respiratory tract infections: Symptoms like a common cold.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, which can happen even with normal blood sugar levels. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, tiredness, and trouble breathing.
Dehydration: Loss of body water and salt that causes dizziness or fainting when standing up.
Serious infections: Severe urinary tract infections, kidney infections, or a rare, life-threatening genital infection called Fournier's gangrene.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if you take Jardiance with insulin or other diabetes drugs.
Lower limb amputations: Increased risk of leg or toe pain, sores, or ulcers.
